statement.excerpt: As I’ve explained, most AI revenues out of Google, Microsoft and Amazon come from two companies that lose billions of dollars a year, have no path to profitability, and are only able to keep paying these companies because the companies (and investors) keep feeding them money.
statement.document_title: Am I Meant To Be Impressed?

from_speaker: most AI revenues out of Google, Microsoft and Amazon
two companies that lose billions of dollars a year
only able to keep paying these companies because the companies (and investors) keep feeding them money
our_interpretation: The two companies are OpenAI and Anthropic.
Most means more than 50% of realized AI revenue attributable to these two customers. The main reading combines the three hyperscalers; company-level shares should also be reported.

Use January–March 2026, the latest completed reporting quarter before the post, for the ongoing revenue and financing assertions. Annual losses require separate annual records and cannot be established by annualizing one quarter.
Read no path to profitability as no economically credible route under the business economics then prevailing, rather than a claim that profitability is impossible forever.
Treat the revenue concentration assertion as an estimate inferred from the surrounding discussion of reported financial figures. No GAAP or other formal accounting basis is specified.
Funding dependence requires evidence of a cash shortfall after operating receipts and available cash, rather than merely evidence that fundraising occurred.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish that the two labs generated more than half of the named hyperscalers' realized AI revenue, that both incurred multibillion-dollar annual losses, and that their operating economics required continuing outside financing without a credible route to profitability.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish a combined revenue share of 50% or less, or establish that a lab could sustainably meet its obligations without continuing outside financing. A substantiated route to profitability would contradict that component.
